q: The polite way to stop a process is …
o: SIGTERM, then SIGKILL if it doesn't exit
why: SIGTERM can be handled for a clean shutdown.

q: A process killed by SIGKILL (signal 9) shows exit status 128 + 9 = ?
A process killed by SIGKILL can catch the signal and clean up.
why: Myth. SIGKILL can't be caught or ignored.
